label: Bible Study
prompt: So when they continued asking him, he lifted up himself, and said unto them, He that is without sin among you, let him first cast a _____ at her.
verse: So when they continued asking him, he lifted up himself, and said unto them, He that is without sin among you, let him first cast a stone at her.
note: Jesus' answer to the accusers — and one by one, from the eldest on down, they all walked away.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: And they shall see his _____; and his name shall be in their foreheads.
verse: And they shall see his face; and his name shall be in their foreheads.
note: Maybe the best line in heaven's description: they shall see His face.

label: Sunday School
prompt: The king spake, and said, Is not this great Babylon, that I have _____ for the house of the kingdom by the might of my power, and for the honour of my majesty?
verse: The king spake, and said, Is not this great Babylon, that I have built for the house of the kingdom by the might of my power, and for the honour of my majesty?
note: Nebuchadnezzar's boast — 'great Babylon, that I have built' — was still in his mouth when the humbling came.

label: Deep Water
prompt: For what is a man profited, if he shall gain the whole world, and lose his own soul? or what shall a man give in _____ for his soul?
verse: For what is a man profited, if he shall gain the whole world, and lose his own soul? or what shall a man give in exchange for his soul?
note: Jesus prices the whole world against one soul — then asks what anyone could possibly offer to buy it back.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: Now unto him that is able to do _____ abundantly above all that we ask or think, according to the power that worketh in us,
verse: Now unto him that is able to do exceeding abundantly above all that we ask or think, according to the power that worketh in us,
note: The doxology that outruns imagination: 'exceeding abundantly above all that we ask or think.'
